info.name: PhonePe PG V2 Custom Checkout
info.description:
PhonePe Payment Gateway - PG V2 Custom Checkout (API-only) integration.

Introduction: Custom Checkout lets you build your own payment UI and drive each payment instrument directly from the API. You create an order (Create Payment) choosing a paymentMode - UPI Intent, UPI Collect, UPI QR, Card, or NetBanking - and PhonePe returns the artifact needed for that mode (intentUrl, qrData, or a redirectUrl). You then confirm the outcome via Order Status and/or webhooks, and refund a completed payment with the Refund APIs.

Folders:
- Authorization -> Get Access Token
- Payment -> Pay - UPI Intent / UPI Collect / UPI QR / Card / NetBanking (all POST /payments/v2/pay, paymentFlow.type = PG)
- Status -> Check Order Status
- Refund -> Initiate Refund, Check Refund Status
- Webhooks (Mock Server) -> pg.order.completed / pg.order.failed / pg.refund.completed / pg.refund.failed callbacks

Credentials: set client_id, client_version, client_secret and tsp_env in the environment. merchantOrderId is auto-generated on every Create run by scripts, and orderId is captured from responses; the access token is fetched/refreshed automatically.

Environments:
- Sandbox: https://api-preprod.phonepe.com/apis/pg-sandbox/<Endpoint>
- Production: Authorization API https://api.phonepe.com/apis/identity-manager/<Endpoint> ; Other APIs https://api.phonepe.com/apis/pg/<Endpoint>

API Endpoints:
- Authorization       POST /v1/oauth/token
- Create Payment      POST /payments/v2/pay
- Check Order Status  GET  /payments/v2/order/{merchantOrderId}/status?details=true
- Initiate Refund     POST /payments/v2/refund
- Check Refund Status GET  /payments/v2/refund/{merchantRefundId}/status

Order states: CREATED -> PENDING -> COMPLETED or FAILED. Rely only on the root-level state for the payment outcome.

Important differences from Standard Checkout:
- paymentFlow.type must be PG (not PG_CHECKOUT) and the base path is /payments/v2 (not /checkout/v2).
- merchantUrls.redirectUrl is mandatory only for CARD, TOKEN and NET_BANKING.
- CARD payments are PCI-DSS scoped: card data must be RSA-4096 encrypted, and in PRODUCTION the Card pay endpoint uses a different host: https://cards.phonepe.com/apis/pg/payments/v2/pay.

Note: For Partner integrations, add an X-MERCHANT-ID header with the end merchant's MerchantID on every call.

Docs:
- Introduction: https://developer.phonepe.com/phonepe-payment-gateway/pg-v2-custom-checkout-integration/
- Authorization: https://developer.phonepe.com/payment-gateway-custom-checkout/custom-api-integration/authorization
- Initiate Payment: https://developer.phonepe.com/payment-gateway-custom-checkout/custom-api-integration/initiate-payment/upi-intent
- Order Status: https://developer.phonepe.com/payment-gateway-custom-checkout/custom-api-integration/order-status-api
- Refund: https://developer.phonepe.com/payment-gateway-custom-checkout/custom-api-integration/refund-api
- Webhook: https://developer.phonepe.com/payment-gateway-custom-checkout/custom-api-integration/webhook
- UAT Sandbox: https://developer.phonepe.com/payment-gateway/uat-testing-go-live/uat-sandbox

request.description: Generate the O-Bearer access token required to authenticate all Custom Checkout API requests. Include the returned access_token in the Authorization header (O-Bearer <token>) for all subsequent calls, and refresh before expires_at. https://developer.phonepe.com/payment-gateway-custom-checkout/custom-api-integration/authorization

Initiate a UPI Intent payment. amount is in paisa (min 100). deviceContext.deviceOS is ANDROID or IOS (for iOS also send merchantCallBackScheme). paymentMode.targetApp is the UPI app to open - on Android a package name (e.g. com.phonepe.app), on iOS a value like PHONEPE/GPAY/PAYTM. The response returns orderId, state PENDING and intentUrl - open intentUrl to launch the chosen UPI app. https://developer.phonepe.com/payment-gateway-custom-checkout/custom-api-integration/initiate-payment/upi-intent

Initiate a UPI Collect payment. A collect request is pushed to the customer's UPI app for the given VPA (details.type VPA + vpa, or UPI_NUMBER + upiNumber). message is shown to the payer. The response returns orderId and state PENDING; the customer approves the request in their UPI app. https://developer.phonepe.com/payment-gateway-custom-checkout/custom-api-integration/initiate-payment/upi-collect-api/upi-collect

Initiate a UPI QR payment. The response returns orderId, state PENDING, intentUrl and qrData - render qrData as a QR code for the customer to scan with any UPI app. https://developer.phonepe.com/payment-gateway-custom-checkout/custom-api-integration/initiate-payment/upi-qr

Initiate a Card payment. PCI-DSS scoped: encryptedCardNumber and encryptedCvv must be RSA-4096 encrypted with PhonePe's public key (encryptionKeyId identifies the key). authMode 3DS triggers 3-D Secure. merchantUrls.redirectUrl is mandatory. The response returns orderId, state PENDING and a redirectUrl for 3DS - redirect the customer there. IMPORTANT: in PRODUCTION the Card pay endpoint host is https://cards.phonepe.com/apis/pg/payments/v2/pay (override api_base_url for this call). https://developer.phonepe.com/payment-gateway-custom-checkout/custom-api-integration/initiate-payment/card

Initiate a NetBanking payment. bankId is the bank identifier (e.g. HDFC). merchantUrls.redirectUrl is mandatory. The response returns orderId, state PENDING and a redirectUrl to the bank's netbanking page - redirect the customer there to complete payment. https://developer.phonepe.com/payment-gateway-custom-checkout/custom-api-integration/initiate-payment/netbanking

Fetch the latest status of an order. details=true returns every payment attempt under paymentDetails (false returns only the latest); errorContext=true returns the errorContext block when the state is FAILED. Root-level state is CREATED, PENDING, COMPLETED or FAILED - rely on it for the payment outcome. https://developer.phonepe.com/payment-gateway-custom-checkout/custom-api-integration/order-status-api

Same as Check Order Status but with settlementDetails=true, which additionally returns a settlementDetails object: state (NOT_INITIATED / INITIATED / PROCESSED / ATTEMPT_FAILED), splitSettlementDetails[] and accountsSettlementDetails[] with amountBreakup (transactionAmount, settlementAmount, fee, sgst/cgst/igst, commission) and utr/settlementId. Populated once the order is COMPLETED and settled. https://developer.phonepe.com/payment-gateway/website-integration/standard-checkout/api-integration/api-reference/order-status-with-settlement/

Initiate a refund against a completed order. merchantRefundId is a unique refund ID (auto-generated by the pre-request script). originalMerchantOrderId is the order to refund. amount is in paisa (min 100) and must be <= the amount originally captured. The response returns refundId and state PENDING. https://developer.phonepe.com/payment-gateway-custom-checkout/custom-api-integration/refund-api

Fetch the status of a refund by merchantRefundId. state is PENDING, COMPLETED or FAILED; splitInstruments describes how the amount was returned. https://developer.phonepe.com/payment-gateway-custom-checkout/custom-api-integration/refund-api

item.name: Webhooks (Mock Server)
item.description: Sample PhonePe S2S callbacks for Custom Checkout. Right-click this folder -> Mock Collection to create a Postman mock server, then set mock_base_url to the generated URL. PhonePe signs callbacks with Authorization: SHA256(username:password) (set webhook_auth_sha256 to mirror it). Supported events: pg.order.completed, pg.order.failed, pg.refund.completed, pg.refund.failed. Configure the webhook URL and events in the PhonePe Business Dashboard -> Developer Settings -> Webhooks. https://developer.phonepe.com/payment-gateway-custom-checkout/custom-api-integration/webhook

request.description: Sample pg.order.completed callback, sent when an order is successfully completed. Use the root-level payload.state to confirm the payment.
Sample pg.order.failed callback, sent when an order fails (or expires). paymentDetails carries errorCode/detailedErrorCode for the failed attempt.
Sample pg.refund.completed callback, sent when a refund is successfully processed.
Sample pg.refund.failed callback, sent when refund processing fails. errorCode/detailedErrorCode describe the failure.
